title: ci: show only screenshots of the pages a PR touched

catches.what: a Plan feature change picked the mobile Today screenshots, because / renders today, log and plan; found by running the picker on the real CI screenshots
#37's verification.yaml did not parse as YAML (unquoted ': ' and leading quotes); fixed in the oracle commit
a feature whose spec captured nothing fell back to every screenshot; plus stale comment when nothing is picked, index imports missed, cwd-relative spec path, live PR file list (see PR thread)

notes: Self-written tests from the first version were removed; the oracle kept the changesRendering cases and added 20. It ran Stryker unprompted: 9 survivors, all order, equivalent anchors or CLI-only. Rebase onto #37 conflicted on verification.yaml (deleted in #37, edited by this PR's oracle commit); the implementer resolved it by keeping the deletion, so the oracle commit now carries only tests and fixtures.
